title: Understanding Futures Contracts and Margin Trading
subtitle: How futures are priced, margined, settled, and taxed on NSE, and how to use leverage without blowing up
description: An advanced, mechanics-first course on futures contracts and leveraged trading for experienced retail investors, active traders, and HNIs who already know what a futures contract is. Covers contract specifications, cost of carry and basis, open interest and rollover, the full NSE Clearing margin stack (SPAN, exposure, mark-to-market, peak margin, shortfall penalties), broker square-off rules, Margin Trading Facility (MTF) and pledging, directional and hedging strategies with Nifty and stock futures, calendar spreads, cash-futures arbitrage, physical settlement, MWPL ban periods, and the taxation of F&O income in India. Built around live NSE contract data, SEBI circulars, and Zerodha-style broker mechanics.
whatYouLearn: Read any NSE futures contract specification and compute fair value from the cost of carry
Explain exactly how SPAN, exposure, and peak margins are computed and why margin calls happen
Use Margin Trading Facility and pledging correctly, and compute the true cost of leverage
Hedge a stock portfolio with Nifty futures using beta-weighted hedge ratios
Run calendar spreads, rollovers, and cash-futures arbitrage with realistic costs
Handle physical settlement, MWPL ban periods, and file F&O income correctly
